Raw TeX math markup left in: var$i$, v$ij$, x$ijk$, fn$i$ (12 occurrences). TeX is \param{var$\sub{i}$} etc. Fix: drop the $ signs, leaving vari (as used elsewhere, e.g. Oi). One fix replaces the whole first paragraph.

fix.old: In some containing form, F, this declaration asserts for each var$i$ (which need not be bound by F), and for each value v$ij$ that var$i$ takes on, and for each object x$ijk$ that is an otherwise inaccessible part of v$ij$ at any time when v$ij$ becomes the value of var$i$, that just after the execution of F terminates, x$ijk$ is either inaccessible (if F established a binding for var$i$) or still an otherwise inaccessible part of the current value of var$i$ (if F did not establish a binding for var$i$). The same relation holds for each fn$i$, except that the bindings are in the function namespace.
fix.new: In some containing form, F, this declaration asserts for each vari (which need not be bound by F), and for each value vij that vari takes on, and for each object xijk that is an otherwise inaccessible part of vij at any time when vij becomes the value of vari, that just after the execution of F terminates, xijk is either inaccessible (if F established a binding for vari) or still an otherwise inaccessible part of the current value of vari (if F did not establish a binding for vari). The same relation holds for each fni, except that the bindings are in the function namespace.
